summary: Practise RCSAs, control testing, KRI escalation and incident analysis. Explore the five-day operational risk course and assess its fit for your team.
lede: Operational risk training helps risk, internal-control and business-risk practitioners assess process exposures and evaluate control effectiveness. Through practical exercises, they build RCSA records and linked action plans, test controls against evidence, analyze incidents and root causes, define KRI thresholds, and assign remediation actions for reporting and oversight.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for practitioners who assess operational exposures, evaluate controls, monitor incidents and indicators, or coordinate remediation and risk reporting.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with operational-risk assessments, internal controls, incident reporting or risk reporting is expected. No programming is required.
